data_integrity_rules: Only datasets from official government geological surveys (e.g., GSI, IBM), scientific institutions (e.g., USGS, NASA, ESA), and authoritative remote sensing portals (e.g., Copernicus, Bhuvan) are accepted.
No scraped, unverified GitHub, Kaggle, or AI-synthesized datasets are permitted.
Independent validation occurrences must originate outside the Ghondi reference deposit training footprint.
No synthetic negative samples or artificial controls may be generated.

datasets.audit_phase9_notes: Authoritative sources audited: GSI (Bhukosh / NGDR), IBM Mineral Inventory Database, Ministry of Mines, ISRO Bhuvan. Usable unauthenticated machine-readable vector data is unavailable via public endpoints without authenticated registration, cart checkout, and offline email delivery. In accordance with strict scientific data integrity policy, synthetic/scraped/model-derived coordinates are forbidden and validation status remains NOT_AVAILABLE.
